title: Bento: free PowerPoint alternative
caption:
Microsoft 365 charges $9.99/month to make slide decks. Bento does it for free 📊

✅ The whole deck is one single file: open it in any browser to edit and present
✅ Morph animations between slides, built-in charts, PDF export
✅ Encrypted live collaboration, and it works offline
✅ No subscription, no account, no installer

💻 Any browser
ℹ️ Bento works best on a desktop browser: phones are good for viewing and presenting, but editing is desktop-first. Live collaboration uses an optional relay that only sees encrypted data, and Offline mode turns it off.

Comment "SLIDES" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
